// Generated by @mimen/generative-ui-pack. Do not edit.
import type { GalleryComponent } from "@/lib/copilot/gallery-registry";
import type { Tone } from "@mimen/generative-ui-pack/core";
import {
  Checklist,
  Metrics,
  Quote,
  Record,
} from "@mimen/generative-ui-pack/react";
import {
  openBotChecklistBinding,
  openBotMetricsBinding,
  openBotQuoteBinding,
  openBotRecordBinding,
} from "@mimen/generative-ui-pack/openbot";
import { z } from "zod";

function portableEntry(
  binding:
    | typeof openBotRecordBinding
    | typeof openBotMetricsBinding
    | typeof openBotChecklistBinding
    | typeof openBotQuoteBinding,
  Component: GalleryComponent["Component"],
): GalleryComponent {
  return {
    name: binding.toolName,
    title: binding.title,
    kind: binding.kind,
    description: binding.description,
    parameters: binding.inputSchema,
    Component,
    preview: { ...binding.preview },
    confirmation: binding.confirmation,
  };
}

const StreamTone = z
  .string()
  .optional()
  .transform((value): Tone | undefined => {
    if (
      value === "neutral" ||
      value === "positive" ||
      value === "caution" ||
      value === "negative"
    ) {
      return value;
    }
    return undefined;
  });
const StreamRecord = z
  .object({
    title: z.string().optional(),
    subtitle: z.string().optional(),
    status: z.string().optional(),
    statusTone: StreamTone,
    fields: z
      .array(
        z
          .object({
            label: z.string().optional(),
            value: z.string().optional(),
          })
          .passthrough(),
      )
      .optional(),
  })
  .passthrough();
const StreamMetrics = z
  .object({
    title: z.string().optional(),
    caption: z.string().optional(),
    metrics: z
      .array(
        z
          .object({
            label: z.string().optional(),
            value: z.string().optional(),
            change: z.string().optional(),
            changeTone: StreamTone,
          })
          .passthrough(),
      )
      .optional(),
  })
  .passthrough();
const StreamChecklist = z
  .object({
    title: z.string().optional(),
    caption: z.string().optional(),
    items: z
      .array(
        z
          .object({
            text: z.string().optional(),
            done: z.boolean().optional(),
            note: z.string().optional(),
          })
          .passthrough(),
      )
      .optional(),
  })
  .passthrough();
const StreamQuote = z
  .object({
    quote: z.string().optional(),
    attribution: z.string().optional(),
    context: z.string().optional(),
  })
  .passthrough();

const PortableRecord: GalleryComponent["Component"] = (props) => {
  const parsed = StreamRecord.parse(props);
  return (
    <Record
      {...parsed}
      title={parsed.title ?? ""}
      fields={(parsed.fields ?? []).map((field) => ({
        label: field.label ?? "",
        value: field.value ?? "",
      }))}
    />
  );
};
const PortableMetrics: GalleryComponent["Component"] = (props) => {
  const parsed = StreamMetrics.parse(props);
  return (
    <Metrics
      {...parsed}
      title={parsed.title ?? ""}
      metrics={(parsed.metrics ?? []).map((metric) => ({
        label: metric.label ?? "",
        value: metric.value ?? "",
        change: metric.change,
        changeTone: metric.changeTone,
      }))}
    />
  );
};
const PortableChecklist: GalleryComponent["Component"] = (props) => {
  const parsed = StreamChecklist.parse(props);
  return (
    <Checklist
      {...parsed}
      title={parsed.title ?? ""}
      items={(parsed.items ?? []).map((item) => ({
        text: item.text ?? "",
        done: item.done ?? false,
        note: item.note,
      }))}
    />
  );
};
const PortableQuote: GalleryComponent["Component"] = (props) => {
  const parsed = StreamQuote.parse(props);
  return (
    <Quote
      {...parsed}
      quote={parsed.quote ?? ""}
      attribution={parsed.attribution ?? ""}
    />
  );
};

export const OPENBOT_CARD_GALLERY: GalleryComponent[] = [
  portableEntry(openBotRecordBinding, PortableRecord),
  portableEntry(openBotMetricsBinding, PortableMetrics),
  portableEntry(openBotChecklistBinding, PortableChecklist),
];

export const OPENBOT_QUOTE_GALLERY: GalleryComponent[] = [
  portableEntry(openBotQuoteBinding, PortableQuote),
];
